title: Condensed constant Weil object and compact-support realization
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, $E=\mathbf Q_\ell\subset\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, and a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme $Y_0$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Put $Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$, $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, and let $a_Y:Y\to s$ be the structure map. Let $E_Y$ be the rationalized constant adic object with the normalized integral model of [lem-zl-constant-weil-datum]. Write $E_T^c=p_T^*\underline E$ and $U_T=p_T^*\underline\Omega$ for $T=Y,s$, where $\underline\Omega=\operatorname{Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj}(\ell)$ is exactly [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed], and use the coefficient map $E_T^c\to U_T$ of [def-sfb-subfield-to-qlbar-coefficient-map]. Let $J_T$ be the adic-to-condensed $E$ realization of [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-e-realization]. In the actual module-object category [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible], form
$$K=U_Y\otimes^L_{E_Y^c}J_Y(E_Y).$$
Here scalar extension means the derived extension of module objects along the displayed coefficient map [sk-def-sfb-derived-extension-of-scalars]. There is a canonical isomorphism $J_Y(E_Y)\cong E_Y^c$ and hence $K\cong U_Y$ in degree zero. For the $k$-linear model Frobenius $\Phi$ (the base change of the $q$-power Frobenius of $Y_0$), the unit pullback isomorphism defines $\phi:L\Phi^*K\xrightarrow{\sim}K$ [def-sfb-module-upper-star]. It makes $(K,\phi)$ an actual $\operatorname{WeilBoundedConstructibleOfEnd}\ \ell\ \Phi$ of the coefficient category in [nt-assume-trace-formula], and is the image of the normalized model Weil structure after reconstructing its compatible integral tower, rationalizing it to $E$, applying $J_Y$, and extending from $E_Y^c$ to $U_Y$. Its iterates use the canonical pullback-composition comparisons.

Let $C_E=R\Gamma_c(Y,E_Y)$ be the ordinary $E$-complex of [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology], which belongs to $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E)$ by [prop-cohomological-finiteness], and use $\rho_{E,s}$ of [lem-zl-condensed-point-supertrace]. The canonical compact-support coefficient comparison and point realization give a specified isomorphism in $D^b_c(s)[[\underline\Omega]]$
$$\sigma_Y:Ra_{Y!}^{\mathrm{cond}}K\xrightarrow{\sim}\rho_{E,s}(C_E),$$
where $Ra_{Y!}^{\mathrm{cond}}$ is the chosen-compactification module-object functor of [sk-def-sfb-dc-lower-shriek]. On cohomology this gives the internal module $\rho_{E,s}(H_c^i(Y,E)[0])$; its geometric-point value is $H_c^i(Y,E)\otimes_E\Omega$. For every $k$-point $x:s\to Y$, there is a canonical isomorphism $\lambda_x:Lx^*K\xrightarrow{\sim}U_s=\rho_{E,s}(E[0])$. If $\Phi^m\circ x=x$, the stalk operator obtained from $\phi_m$ and this fixed-point equality is carried by $\lambda_x$ to $1_{U_s}$. All the comparisons asserted here concern actual condensed module objects, rather than identifying the adic and condensed coefficient categories by notation. No equality between their global Frobenius operators, and no trace or dualizability assertion, is part of this statement.
